description: Check target sizes and spacing against WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 (24 by 24 CSS px, or a smaller target with enough spacing), the 44px guidance for iOS and the web, and 48dp for Android. Pass targets as a list of {name, width, height, gap, inline} or text lines like 'Save button 40x32 gap=8'. Returns pass or fail per guideline with advice.

gap.description: Spacing to the nearest other target

inline.description: A link inside a sentence, which is exempt

name: check_touch_targets
title: Touch targets
